approved.name: Banquet chairs
approved.alt: Red upholstered metal-frame banquet chairs arranged around event tables
approved.visualReview: Sharp foreground upholstered banquet chairs are clearly identifiable. Event venue background; not the business's exact stock. Use lower central crop focusing the complete foreground chair if useful.

approved.name: Gaddi and floor mattresses
approved.alt: Traditional magenta Indian gaddi floor mattress with cushions in Jaipur
approved.visualReview: Real traditional Indian floor mattress and backrest, with visible textile detail. Crop lower portion to make mattress subject prominent and remove ornate ceiling. Representative heritage arrangement, not exact rental inventory.
approved.changes: Crop, resize and WebP conversion must be acknowledged; link photographer/source and license on public image credits.

approved.name: Cocktail and high tables
approved.alt: Tall round cocktail tables dressed in white and blue cloth for an event
approved.visualReview: Sharp real photograph with five complete high-top tables clearly visible. Suitable representative event setup. Crop left 80% removes incidental person while retaining four full tables.

approved.name: Buffet tables
approved.alt: Long dark buffet tables with visible pedestal supports arranged for event serving
approved.visualReview: Unlike food close-ups, entire long tabletop and substantial pedestal supports visible. Real event buffet-table arrangement; not exact inventory.

blockers.reason: Bajot 01/02 are mislabelled hookah detail photographs. Odisha museum table is woven rope, not a solid low wooden chowki. Continuing museum sources.

blockers.reason: No approved distinct photograph yet; traditional furniture researchers' excellent chowki photographs lack reusable license.

blockers.reason: LifetimeTable.jpg 469px inadequate resolution; Lifetime Folding Table.jpg 1200px shows partial craft table. Seeking clearer full rectangular banquet table.

approved.name: Tablecloths and chadar
approved.alt: Red tablecloth draped over a round reception table
approved.review: Clear red tablecloth covers most of frame, hem and edge visible; styled event context. Not an assertion of rental inventory or chadar material.

approved.name: Napkins
approved.alt: Folded navy cloth napkins with silver cutlery on a white tablecloth
approved.review: Two folded navy cloth napkins clearly visible and sharp in a simple table setting; material not asserted.

approved.name: Chair covers
approved.alt: White fitted chair covers with ties around a reception table
approved.review: Foreground chairs are fully visible wearing white fabric covers to the floor; useful event context, not tiny background objects. Original image 4608×3456; selected licensed 1280×960 downloadable derivative.

approved.name: Chair sashes
approved.alt: Black fabric sashes tied in bows around white event chairs
approved.review: Black fabric sashes prominent and clearly distinguishable against white chairs; beach background subdued; entire sash length visible.

approved.name: Ceiling drapes
approved.alt: Pink and cream fabric drapes suspended in swags overhead
approved.review: Low-angle photograph with fabric ceiling swags as dominant subject; no people or generic wedding scene. Downloaded preview 1100×733; original dimensions not yet obtained.

approved.name: Wall drapes and parda
approved.alt: Red fabric curtain with clearly defined vertical pleats
approved.review: Curtain is sole subject; real textured fabric and crisp pleats. Does not establish specific event installation or rental inventory.

rejected.reason: Camera watermark and dining venue scene.
Archival catalogue card, not product photograph.
Silk material and reuse rights verified but historic textile has a large visible stain, unsuitable product presentation.

optional_representative.name: Silk runners
optional_representative.alt: Representative silk and metallic thread table runner with orange decorative motifs
optional_representative.review: Museum professional isolated photograph of a real silk table runner, dated late 19th–early 20th century, Japan. Some historic fading; actual material is verified by museum, but it is not a modern event inventory photograph. Parent should judge suitability before approval.

blockers.name: Silk runners
blockers.reason: No modern licensed photograph with independently verified silk material found. Optional public-domain historic museum runner supplied separately, not automatically approved.

blockers.name: Brocade runners
blockers.reason: Searches across Pexels, Unsplash, Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons, museum open collections and commercial product sources did not verify a suitable reuse-cleared brocade table runner photograph. Commercial exact product images have no reuse permission; generic shiny runners do not establish brocade construction. Museum brocade textiles without runner identity are not suitable substitutes.

approved.name: Stage setups
approved.alt: A white and blush wedding stage with an ornate loveseat, floral pedestals and hanging flowers
approved.visualReview: Complete raised event stage and seating installation is the main subject; genuine camera capture with source EXIF.

approved.name: Sweetheart table setups
approved.alt: A decorated sweetheart table for two with floral garland and candles in an outdoor setting
approved.visualReview: Clearly two-person sweetheart table. Original is portrait with substantial empty woods above; crop around table and both chair backs.

approved.name: Pillars and stambh
approved.alt: Carved golden ceremonial pillars supporting a flower-decorated Indian wedding mandap
approved.visualReview: Four decorated golden stambh are clearly visible in ceremonial installation. Representative installed pillars rather than isolated freestanding inventory.

approved.name: Arches
approved.alt: A freestanding outdoor wedding arch covered with white and blush flowers
approved.visualReview: Entire floral arch, both legs and curve visible. Bright high-key exposure; product details remain legible.

approved.name: Floral backdrops
approved.alt: A white flower wall forming a wedding backdrop behind a reception table
approved.visualReview: Clearly installed floral backdrop spans most of photograph. Foreground flowers are intentionally out of focus; backdrop itself is sharp.

approved.name: Fabric backdrops
approved.alt: An ivory fabric event backdrop with crossed drapes and warm decorative lights
approved.visualReview: Full fabric backdrop installation main subject with two small seats in foreground; use contain to retain fabric arrangement.

approved.name: Frame backdrops
approved.alt: A black freestanding event backdrop frame hung with white fabric and greenery
approved.visualReview: Black rectangular support frame is clearly visible along top and right side. Draped wedding/event backdrop installation; frame is prominent and no people.

approved.name: Tents, canopies, and shamiyana
approved.alt: A large white event marquee tent with peaked roof and clear side panels
approved.visualReview: Tent is dominant subject. Representative event marquee, does not establish traditional shamiyana or offered inventory. No camping-tent substitution.

approved.name: Urlis
approved.alt: A shallow copper-colored decorative urli filled with water and floating flowers
approved.visualReview: Clearly shallow decorative metal basin with floating flowers, photographed overhead. Real visible texture and aged rim, no AI. Source labels decorative brass bowl.

approved.name: Katori
approved.alt: Small stainless steel katori bowls serving an Indian meal on a round tray
approved.visualReview: Three metal katori bowls clearly visible close-up; genuine Indian serving context. Some filled bowls in foreground have intentional depth of field; bowl shape legible. Representative filled serving vessels, not exact inventory.
